# relgap registry lint

Without arguments, checks the entries embedded in relgap. With arguments, checks those files.

Reports unknown keys and wrong types; regular expressions that don't compile (version.exclude,
version.extract and source headings); version.scheme regex without version.extract and the
reverse; unknown placeholders in path\_template, url\_template, ref and anchor; a url\_template
host relgap doesn't fetch from; CSS selectors in content and strip that don't parse; and a name
that doesn't match the file name. Each problem has file:line:column, and lint exits 2 when there
is any.

## Usage

```sh
relgap registry lint [file...]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | no | yes |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `json`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
relgap registry lint
relgap registry lint registry/terraform.yaml
```
